svg.title: Ktemata r5 airbrush scheme - BEARING
svg.desc: Continuity: one lane at x = 215.5. The two panels share an x axis, so the trace is a single 3 mm line that runs from a port ring in the cover, through an 8 mm gateway square on the hinge, to a second port ring in the deck. The lane was chosen by measurement, not by eye: on the deck it clears the Pi opening (ends 203.4), the hinge screw head at 207.5 and the screw at 228.4; on the cover it runs just right of the display opening and straight across the flat painted border. The obvious left rail does not work - x = 17.1 is clear of the deck's hardware, but the FireBeetle access hole (x 14..30, y 148..158) would cut the line 20 mm short of its end. The well also takes the border's hinge band on the cover, so the border there survives only in the two side margins: the trace, not the border, is what crosses the seam.
